summary.text: Dora Drake is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 4, based in Milwaukee.
She serves on the Health and Judiciary and Public Safety committees.

paragraphs.text: Drake was born in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, graduated from Eastbrook Academy in Milwaukee in 2011, and earned a B.A. from Marquette University in 2015.
The Legislature's page lists her occupations as social worker, trauma-informed response facilitator and sales representative.
She was elected to the Assembly for the 2020-22 term before serving in the Senate.
She is a member of the Wisconsin Legislative Black Caucus, which she chaired in 2025, and of the Young Democrats of Wisconsin, and she took part in Emerge Wisconsin's Class of 2020.
